newsitem.title: USA: Endocardial Solutions files for 3 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Endocardial Solutions files for 3 mln share IPO.

text.p: Endocardial Solutions Inc said Thursday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of three million shares of common stock, all being sold by the company.
The proposed offering is being made through Piper Jaffray Inc and Volpe, Welty & Co, and underwriters have an option to buy up to an additional 450,000 shares from the company for overallotments.
Endocardial Solutions is developing a diagnostic system and related disposal cardiac catheters for the electrophysiology market.
